_smoke_note: NOT A RESULT AND NEVER QUOTABLE AS ONE. Tiny atoms (64) and a shortened ladder, gates bypassed. Its only job is to prove the code paths execute: per-domain candidates, per-domain dictionary, per-domain encode + ridge at every ladder point for all 6 domains, M116 global per-domain baseline read, gains/ratios computed, evidence write. Every accuracy it produces is meaningless.

parity_guard.feature: CLS token concatenated with the mean of the patch tokens

scaling.subsample_rule: first n rows of each domain's train rows

gate.kill_switch_specialist_steepness: specialist per-domain gain >= 0.5 x global per-domain gain (bypassed in smoke)
